title: 第20章 贪欲第21章 前夕
slug: 以下犯上徒弟着实貌美
lines: 夜深人静，飞舟在云层中平稳航行。
楚安芷站在窗前，望着窗外皎洁的月光，心中思绪万千。
今日在食堂见到赵归涯那惊人的多线处理能力，让她对这个徒弟又有了新的认识。
“他到底还藏着多少秘密……”
楚安芷轻声自语。
犹豫片刻，她决定去找赵归涯聊聊。
刚踏出门，手腕上的通灵宝银镯突然微微发热，赵归涯的声音传入脑海：
「拒当牛马未」：师尊，你是要来找我吗？
楚安芷一怔。
「安知非我命」：你怎么知道？
「拒当牛马未」：我的精神力覆盖了整个飞舟，你出门就知道了。
「拒当牛马未」：我在顶层观星台，要上来坐坐吗？
「安置费我命」：好
楚安芷无奈摇头，这徒弟的警惕性也太高了。
她顺着楼梯来到飞舟顶层，推开观星台的门，眼前的景象让她微微愣神……
赵归涯斜倚在软榻上，手中把玩着那柄化为羽扇的‘斩愿’。
月光如水，倾泻在他身上，为他镀上一层银辉。
飞舟上都是熟人，赵归涯也就没戴面具，那张俊美的脸在月色下更显妖异，唇下那颗浅红的贪吃痣格外醒目。
风翼蜷在他身边，睡得正香。
“师尊。”
赵归涯坐直身子，拍了拍身旁的位置，“来坐。”
楚安芷走过去坐下：“这么晚还不休息？”
赵归涯指了指身前的光幕：“这不是还没忙完嘛，我打算今天就把事情处理的七七八八，后面就轻松了。”
“你也真是够拼的。”
“我比较喜欢把事情一次性做完，”
赵归涯看着光幕，“也是因为我做事做的快，老妈就是看中这点，很喜欢把一堆她来不及做的事，或者拖了很久的事扔给我。”
楚安芷忍不住笑道：“看来你母亲很信任你。”
赵归涯耸了耸肩：“她信任我是好事，就是苦了我这‘牛马’。”
说罢，还故意装出一副可怜兮兮的模样。
楚安芷被他的样子逗乐：“就你会贫嘴。”
“话说师尊，您来找我是有什么事吗？”
楚安芷沉默片刻，决定开门见山：“小未，你真的不怨吗？”
月光下，赵归涯闻言一愣。
他收起羽扇，歪头：“嗯？”
“就是原身把你当炉鼎的事。”
楚安芷垂下眼睛，“虽说你之前说不计较，但毕竟以你的家世和你的天赋一旦去研武大会露个脸，你都可以走上巅峰，而不是因为前世原身的贪欲，让你……”
楚安芷话还没说完，一只骨节分明的手轻轻搭在她不知何时握紧成拳头的手上。
她抬起头就撞入了一双含笑的双眸。
“师尊，”
content_en:
In the dead of night, the flying boat sailed smoothly among the clouds.
Chu Anzhi stood in front of the window, looking at the bright moonlight outside the window, with a lot of thoughts in her heart.
Seeing Zhao Guiya's amazing multi-line processing ability in the cafeteria today gave her a new understanding of this apprentice.
"How many secrets does he have hiding..."
Chu Anzhi whispered to herself.
After hesitating for a moment, she decided to talk to Zhao Guiya.
As soon as he stepped out of the door, the psychic silver bracelet on his wrist suddenly became slightly warm, and Zhao Guiya's voice came into his mind:
"Refuse to be a bully": Master, are you coming to see me?
Chu Anzhi was startled.
"Knowing that it is not my life": How do you know?
"Refuse to be a bully": My mental power covers the entire flying boat, you will know it when you go out.
"Refuse to be a bully": I'm on the top observation deck, do you want to come up and sit?
"Rehousing costs my life": OK
Chu Anzhi shook her head helplessly. This apprentice was too vigilant.
She followed the stairs to the top of the flying boat and opened the door to the observatory. The sight in front of her made her slightly stunned...
Zhao Guiya was leaning on the soft couch, playing with the 'Wish-cutting' that turned into a feather fan in his hand.
The moonlight was like water, pouring on him, coating him with a layer of silver.
There were all acquaintances on the flying boat, so Zhao Guiya didn't wear a mask. His handsome face looked even more enchanting under the moonlight, and the light red greedy mole under his lip was particularly eye-catching.
Fengyi curled up next to him, sleeping soundly.
"Master."
Zhao Guiya sat up straight and patted the seat next to him, "Come and sit."
Chu Anzhi walked over and sat down: "Why don't you rest so late?"
Zhao Guiya pointed to the light curtain in front of him: "I'm not done yet. I plan to handle everything today, and it will be easier later."
"You are really hardworking."
"I prefer to get things done in one go,"
Zhao Guiya looked at the light screen and said, "It's also because I do things quickly. My mother likes to give me a bunch of things that she has no time to do or things that have been put off for a long time."
Chu Anzhi couldn't help but smile and said: "It seems that your mother trusts you very much."
Zhao Guiya shrugged: "It's a good thing that she trusts me, but it's just a pain in the ass for me."
After all, he deliberately pretended to look pitiful.
Chu Anzhi was amused by his appearance: "You are the only one who knows how to talk."
"By the way, Master, why did you come to see me?"
Chu Anzhi was silent for a moment and decided to get straight to the point: "Xiao Wei, do you really not complain?"
Under the moonlight, Zhao Guiya was stunned when he heard this.
He put away his feather fan and tilted his head: "Huh?"
"It's just because the original person used you as a furnace."
Chu Anzhi lowered her eyes, "Although you said you don't care before, after all, with your family background and your talent, once you show up at the martial arts competition, you can reach the top, and it is not because of the greed of your previous life that made you..."
Before Chu Anzhi finished speaking, a hand with clear joints gently placed on her hand that she didn't know when she had clenched into a fist.
She raised her head and met a pair of smiling eyes.
"Master,"
